doc: Ch17 field tunables (M5-A3P-1001; as ch09_field.json). Read by Ch17Zone (game/levels/ch17/ch17_zone.gd). hold: the held inputs of the ledger's page-turns (B05) and the first lamp (B10): between <<event hold_input <prompt>>> and <<event hold_input_end>> in a scene, the scene's time runs only while `action` is held (CutsceneHoldGate). prompts maps each prompt id to its loc key (game/data/loc/ch17.csv); layer and bottom_px as Ch9's.
